notes: Fully passive, unpowered mechanical video patchbay — no power connector/port exists on this unit (confirmed absent across all sources checked). 64 total circuit points (2 rows x 32), each a straight-through, non-normalled connection between one front Mini-WECO (midsize) jack and one rear BNC jack; represented above as 4 grouped port entries (32 identical points each) rather than 128 individual rows since the connector schema has no per-entry quantity field. True 75-ohm impedance, rated for SD/HD/UHD/4K/8K/HDR-SDI signals; compliant with SMPTE ST292M, ST424M, ST2081-1 (6G-SDI) and ST2082-1 (12G-SDI) — grade set to sdi-12g reflecting the highest confirmed SMPTE-SDI standard supported (marketing also cites "12G+"/"24GHz" bandwidth headroom beyond the 12G-SDI spec, but no higher SMPTE-SDI standard, e.g. 24G-SDI/ST2083, is explicitly claimed). Manufacturer's own product page (bittree.com) was rate-limited (HTTP 429) on every fetch attempt during research, so this entry is sourced from Markertek's spec table, cross-confirmed against AV-iQ and Full Compass listing titles/snippets, which is an explicitly acceptable retailer source per task instructions. Mini-WECO is not present in the given connector-id taxonomy; "bnc" was used as the closest match for the front jacks since Mini-WECO is mechanically/functionally a compact 75-ohm broadcast video patch connector in the same family as BNC (SDI cross-connect), though it is a push-on (non-bayonet) connector distinct from true BNC — flagged per-port above. Dimensions/weight were not found on any source checked.
